topic: Cleaning device session data for facility
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on reviewing and cleaning historical device session data for a specific facility (52760). Initial checks revealed that two boxes were linked to the facility at some point. The participants discussed filtering the dataset, specifically whether to restrict results using `box_mac in ('20972786c089')` or if general cleaning was required.

It was decided that sessions associated with a specific MAC address (`20972786c089`) should be filtered out, and the removal of certain device IDs (e.g., `209727841a6e`) needed confirmation regarding whether to delete all records or only those from after another device was added.

Finally, a request was made to remove sessions that occurred during a period when two different sensors were linked to the same facility.
decisions: Remove sessions associated with specific device IDs (e.g., 209727841a6e)
Remove sessions where two sensors were linked to the same facility during a specified period
action_items: [me] to perform data cleaning/filtering on the session table.
